elements.label: 'Book of Omniscience'
elements.description:
I can ask it any question, and the answers that appear on its pages have never been mistaken so far. However, once its creator is mentioned, the phrasing becomes peculiar: it sometimes claims to have been crafted by a shaper of history, sometimes foretells that this person will defeat my army head-on on the other side of the sea, and sometimes declares its own existence as the manifestation of a higher form of mercy. Perhaps it’s best not to take this matter too seriously.

[A tutorial book. Combine it with any copy in Work to receive hints.]

slots.label: Question
slots.description: What do I wish to know?

elements.label: Fissifer, A Name-of-Steel
elements.description: The future Name-of-Steel, once a 120,000-ton self-propelled battleship, is armed with deadly glass cannons and a fire-control system driven by Great technology. To be objective, Fissifer itself is merely an ordinary spirit; yet the perfect fusion of Invisible technology and cutting-edge materials enables it to wield power no less than that of any Long. This is the charm of engineering.

elements.label: Fissifer, Overloaded
elements.description: Fissifer, overloaded with the great cannon, grumbled yet again about the issue with the dock.

elements.label: Wulfie, 'The Mournful Wolf'
elements.description: Sinners bear the agony of the Wolf-Divided at every moment—a spiritual burden that often drives them into an uncommunicable madness. Yet I offered Woolfy a redemption so real and credible, that even one in utter despair could not refuse.

elements.label: Wulfie, Waned
elements.description: Wulfie's eyes lost their focus, icy tears welled up from her eyes, then froze upon her cheeks. The Wolf is whispering.

elements.label: Fr.Constantine, A Doorseeker
elements.description: One of the high-ranking members within the Church of the Unconquered Sun whose stance leans in my favor, a Secret Historian and an (unofficial) Illumination scholar. Most people only recognize him as a passionate and 'radiant' clergyman, yet that is merely the tip of the iceberg in his complex background.

elements.label: Constantine, Left
elements.description: Constantine's attention turned to glass, mirrors, and many more distant vessels... but he would soon return.

elements.label: Fiona, the Rose-Witch
elements.description: Perfumer, gardener and Grail-Long of the Flowermaker in the same time. Possesses an insatiable craving for pleasure, paired with a taste so exacting it seems to contradict it all—rumored to stem from a wretched romance in her mortal days. Not that I had any reason to pry further.

elements.label: Fiona, Secluded
elements.description: Fiona, intoxicated by the illusory yet delightful fragrance of flowers, with cheeks flushed rose-red — it would hardly be wise to disturb her now.

elements.label: Standard-issue Archaize Rifle
elements.description:
An archaize rifle crafted in Scotswood, incised with the fivefold mark of the Many-Winged Ones. Cutting-edge technology enables it to wield mundane ammunition with near-original potency—at the cost of exorbitant ammunition expense. Compromise is ever the way of the world.

[Load it by inserting both the weapon and alloy projectiles into Work. Notably, this weapon does not vanish even when its ammunition is depleted.]

elements.label: Standard-issue Archaize Rifle (Cooling Down)
elements.description: The heat in the chamber had yet to fade.

elements.description:
The chamber holds no rounds.

[A rifle only gains the Edge and Weapon aspects when loaded. Place it with alloy rounds into Work to reload.]

elements.label: Furious Element
elements.description: Hokobald's final creation—though its maker's nature was depraved and pitiable, the device ceaselessly radiates violent light and heat, revealing the astonishing heights his potential could have reached.

elements.label: Furious Element (Cooling Down)
elements.description: Continuing to leave this object's radiation unchecked is dangerous—it's best to wait a little longer before putting it to use.

elements.label: Pearl of Ebbing Tides
elements.description: This is likely all that remains of a fallen Name of the Tide... Perhaps she was once beautiful, perhaps once joyful, but all that has passed into history with that great upheaval. Now, only the instinct for survival persists—undignified and raw.

elements.label: Pearl of Ebbing Tides (Cooling Down)
elements.description: It needs a bit more time to regain its usual brilliance.

elements.label: Dragon's Tooth
elements.description: A fang of an ancient behemoth, still thirsting for the flesh of the weak as in ages past.

elements.label: Dragon's Tooth (Worn)
elements.description: This object lacks the endurance of steel; it requires a period of maintenance before it can withstand the trials of combat once more.

elements.label: Hammer of Glory
elements.description:
In their most resplendent era, the immortals of the Red Rose forged this weapon, certain their leader would wield it to conquer all of Europe. Ambition crumbled to dust, and the artifact was buried alongside its makers. Yet, if I can learn and surpass the limits of those who came before, perhaps it may still witness greater glory. 

[Place it together with Bitterblack Salts into Work to load and unleash its true power.]

elements.label: Hammer of Glory: Ignition!
elements.description: This artifact trembles incessantly from the energy sealed within, while the air warps and shimmers under its hellish heat—a wild force, ready to be unleashed!

elements.label: Hammer of Glory (Cooling Down)
elements.description: Swinging this continuously is perilous even for me—patience is required until it cools.

elements.label: Monster Hunter's Dart
elements.description:
A finely poisoned projectile weapon used by the Colonel’s attendants to hunt monsters and other supernatural beings. Of course, the version I hold is a modified replica—no reason to draw the wrath of the Scarred God over it.

[This weapon can be obtained repeatedly, but each piece can only be used once.]

elements.label: Support From Royalists
elements.description: Nobles, bureaucrats, and members of secret societies—my loyal followers. I may call upon them to aid in my goals or command them to gather resources for me, yet the patience of mortals is ever finite.

elements.label: Support From Army
elements.description: A mundane unit armed with light firearms.

elements.label: Divine Metal
elements.description: These are the main products of the glassworks beyond conductors and machinery. Not only are they hard and scorching, but saturated with condensed brilliance within, and bound with so many suppressed souls that they could bear the body of a god—yet regrettably, finding a forge suitable for shaping them has now become a distant hope.

elements.label: Divine Metal (Exhausted)
elements.description: I must wait a while before I can harness the power stored within these intricate artifacts again.

elements.label: A Twin-Shadows' Secret
elements.description: “How can two candles cast a single shadow?” For most who seek the Chandler, this riddle bars the way. For me, however, its answer is not so obscure.

elements.label: A Twin-Shadows' Secret (Exhausted)
elements.description: [You need to wait for a short while before using it again. Each upgrade allows the lore to recover faster.]

elements.label: A Uncrowned Ceremony
elements.description: A series of cryptic and contradictory invocations that point — indirectly — to a deity who ascends at dusk, yet remains uncrowned.

elements.label: A Uncrowned Ceremony (Exhausted)
elements.description: [You need to wait for a short while before using it again. Each upgrade allows the lore to recover faster.]

elements.label: A Guess of Burning
elements.description: 'Who is the Chandler?' Before all dust settles, this question can never be truly answered — yet those immortals who serve them faithfully may come to know an approximation.

elements.label: A Guess of Burning (Exhausted)
elements.description: [You need to wait for a short while before using it again. Each upgrade allows the lore to recover faster.]

elements.label: The Chandler's Names
elements.description: Leaves those places one has never entered— And so may every Name of the Chandler emulate Him in breaking in and slipping away. I have already used this secret to cheat death once. May I never have need of it again.

elements.label: The Chandler's Names (Exhausted)
elements.description: [You need to wait for a short while before using it again. Each upgrade allows the lore to recover faster.]

elements.label: Art of the Unusual Artisan
elements.description: Every fusion allows the old flame to be reborn in a new vessel. While wax endures, the candle never dies.

elements.label: Art of the Unusual Artisan (Exhausted)
elements.description: [You need to wait for a short while before using it again. Each upgrade allows the lore to recover faster.]

elements.label: A Paradox of Light and Shadow
elements.description: Illusions and lies lead us astray from the Glory, yet in doing so, they become reflections of the truth. Things that seem contradictory often share a common essence—and it is through this that the Chandler comes to understand the Glory.

elements.label: A Paradox of Light and Shadow (Exhausted)
elements.description: [You need to wait for a short while before using it again. Each upgrade allows the lore to recover faster.]

elements.label: Mysteries of Burning Candle
elements.description: While lighting the way ahead, one is always shaping oneself. The paradoxical nature of the candle frees it from the bonds of common logic, yet also dooms it to never fully know itself—for the latter changes without end.

elements.label: Mysteries of Burning Candle (Exhausted)
elements.description: [You need to wait for a short while before using it again. Each upgrade allows the lore to recover faster.]
